Renovating a Home That Was Never Meant to Be Ordinary At Renovation Brothers, the luxury home renovations we deliver across Salt Lake City are built to a standard that leaves little room for compromise. Our clients have already decided to renovate. What they want from us is confidence that the people running the work understand what their home takes, and can see it through from the first drawing to the final walkthrough. That is what we have done for more than fifteen years, across thousands of completed projects in Salt Lake City, Park City, and the surrounding areas. ‍ What an Ambitious Renovation Demands A large-scale renovation calls for more than good crews and quality materials. It takes a builder who can hold the whole picture, and that is where our experience shows. Honoring the design. When a home is built to a specific vision, every material and detail has to serve it. We build to the intent, not around it, so the result reads as one coherent piece rather than a set of compromises. Managing how the trades connect. Structural, mechanical, and finish work on a home this size are closely tied together. A choice in one area affects several others, and we keep those pieces aligned because we watch the entire project, not only the part in front of us. Getting the details right the first time. A home like this rewards precision from the start. We work to the standard it calls for from day one, so the quality is built in rather than corrected later. ‍ How We Manage a Renovation of This Kind As a design-build general contractor in Salt Lake City, we keep the entire project under one team, which is what makes work like this possible. Design and Construction Under One Roof Our design-build approach keeps design and construction in-house, under one team. On a project this involved, it matters more than almost anything else we do. One team from first sketch to final build. The people shaping your design and the crew building it answer to the same leadership. Nothing is handed to a subcontractor who was never part of the original plan. Nothing lost between design and build. Most renovation problems live in the space between the two. Keeping both in-house closes that space, so the plan you approved is the one that gets built. What you approve is what you receive. The same team is accountable for the drawing and the result. From First Drawing to Final Walkthrough Clients who renovate on this scale expect the process to be handled with care. It is. Clarity established before the work begins. We settle scope, sequence, and expectations at the outset, so the project starts from a shared understanding rather than an optimistic guess. Coordination we hold ourselves. With design and build in-house, we schedule the trades and manage how they depend on one another, which is what keeps an involved renovation moving and on track. A finish we stand behind. We hold the details to the standard our clients expect, and back every completed project with a one-year workmanship warranty. Working Alongside Your Architect Many of our clients come to us with an architect and a design already in place. We are built to work with them, not around them. We read the intent behind the drawings. Years of work on design-driven homes let us protect that vision through every stage of the build. We keep the design intact when the site tests it. When construction turns up what the drawings did not anticipate, we find the answer that holds the design rather than the one that is easiest to build. We are candid about tradeoffs. When a decision has to be made, we lay out what it means before it is made, not after. ‍ Luxury Home Renovation Across Salt Lake City and the Surrounding Areas Homes That Match Their Setting Properties worth building for. From established Salt Lake City neighborhoods to homes in Park City, Sandy, Holladay, and the surrounding areas, we take on work where the finished result is expected to live up to where it sits. We know this region. Our work is rooted here. We understand the homes, the trades, and what it takes to build well in this part of Utah. Built to Last Materials chosen for the long run. We specify and detail the work to hold for decades, so the finish looks as considered years from now as it does the day we hand over the keys. Ready when you are. For clients whose homes sit empty part of the year, we run the project knowing you are not always on site, and make sure the home is ready the day you return. ‍ Why Salt Lake City Homeowners Trust Renovation Brothers Experience that fits the work. More than fifteen years and thousands of completed renovations across Salt Lake City and the surrounding areas, from single rooms to whole home renovations. A family-owned business. Our name is on every project, and the way we work with clients reflects it: directly, personally, and up close. A standard we stand behind. We get the details right the first time and guarantee our craftsmanship with a one-year workmanship warranty. Choosing who renovates your home comes down to trust.
